articles.title: Florence Pugh Is Tired Of People Making Stuff Up About Her Body (Especially Her Nose): ‘I’m Disturbed’
articles.summary: "Here's the truth..."
articles.content:
Florence Pugh seems to be everywhere these days, from starring in two of the biggest 2026 movies of the year Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three to headlining Netflix's must-watch series, East of Eden . Unfortunately, the more eyes on someone, its often the more scrutiny that follows. With that, Pugh just got real the upsetting discourse she's been seeing about her body as of late.

Pugh has been a longtime advocate for body positivity and rarely ever minces words on the subject. The actress has spoken out about how she's been asked to diet for roles and fired back about comments about her body on the internet and Hollywood double standards before. This time, she spoke specifically to a growing trend online that sees people comparing photos of women and speculating whether they've gotten any plastic surgery done. Pugh cleared things up, saying this:

Not that she owed anyone an explanation! Because Pugh has been "spent [her] whole career defending and protecting bodies that just grow the way they grow" it sounds like she couldn't stand all the discussion, especially around her trademark nose. Pugh even posted this on her Instagram story to prove the point:

Florence Pugh went on to say that her body perhaps looks different this year because when she started the year, she had two New Year's Resolutions: to change her relationship with alcohol and be able to do at least one pull up at the gym. And guess what, she's been working with a trainer all year, and she's able to do it now. As she showed off:

Pugh can now do six pulls ups and lift 243 pounds! She said the accomplishment is "everything" to her and she "worked so hard" to get there before saying she's "looking after [herself], and that's literally it."

Pugh remarked that on one occasion, the size of her thighs were even pointed out in a movie review. But, there's more. The 30-year-old also revealed that she had to sue a few publications this year for buying AI pictures of her getting injectables and published them as "real images". Check out the full message below:

These days, as there's a lot of changing body norms in the media, partially propelled by the rise of GLP-1s , Florence Pugh continues to fight for loving bodies as they are in her latest social media post. You can see her in both Avengers: Doomsday and Dune : Part Three on December 18.

articles.title: I Wasn't Expecting Eternally Yours To Set Up So Many Big Things In Its First Season (And, I'm Pumped)
articles.summary: There's a lot at stake!
articles.content:
SPOILERS ahead for Eternally Yours , now streaming with a Paramount+ subscription , with new episodes dropping on Thursdays.

New comedies can be difficult to get on board with early because oftentimes they need some time to settle in, and not every network or streaming service is willing to bet on them. Eternally Yours has been killing it with its Season One rollout, and is expected to be renewed (per TV Insider ). One plotline that has me excited to tune in for more episodes is what happened in Episode 4, “Halloween”.

That brings me to Episode 6, “Eternal Sunshine of Phyllis’s Mind,” where I think two developments that will have a payoff later came up. The first is the flashback for Emma, where we learn that she had a werewolf stalker named Larry who killed off a number of her boyfriends. Between the loss of the Wolfsbane Chalice and this story, I’m convinced either the finale or an episode down the line will see the return of Larry in the present day, who comes out to get Emma’s new man, Max.

The final setup, which is definitely my favorite, also comes from last week’s episode. Phyllis is one of the best parts of Eternally Yours so far, but I was curious if they would address how messed up it is that her memories are always being wiped.

articles.title: 5 Comic Book Movies That Are Actually Better Than The Comics They’re Based On (1 Was Nominated For 2 Oscars)

articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google In modern cinema, many of the biggest and most beloved movies are based on existing source material. No medium has been better represented in recent years' blockbuster releases than comic books, with countless comic adaptations coming to life on the big screen to varying degrees of success. Many comic book movies take some creative license with their source material, tweaking or completely transforming characters or stories to better suit the vision of the creatives behind the movie adaptation. Sometimes these changes upset or alienate fans, but there are also examples of times when such variations proved to be for the best.

Interestingly, there have been many great comic book movies that actually improve upon their source material. That isn't to say that the original comics weren't great — in fact, in most cases, the comics were excellent to begin with — but rather that the movies took their best ideas and absolutely nailed them on the big screen. Each of the following examples took a comic book character or story and brought it to life in a movie that actually managed to surpass the source material in one way or another.

Sometimes, less is more, and that's an adage that Men in Black employed perfectly in the transition from page to screen. Lowell Cunningham's original comic book was a dark, cynical, and violent exploration of a secret organization policing alien activity, and while it was pretty cool, the movie adaptation in 1997 forged its own identity using the source material as a foundation. Instead of the complex and relatively bleak mythology of the original comics, Men in Black delivered a great, simple sci-fi movie that made particular use of buddy-cop tropes to bring a lighter, more comedic air to its story. The original comics tapped into societal fears of clandestine government agencies, but the movie opted to take that idea and move it further toward the mainstream, resulting in a great and imaginative piece of sci-fi action that felt accessible to audiences of all ages. While the movie lost the edge of the source material, what it gained instead was something that arguably made it much better than the comics.

Some of the best comic book movies have no superheroes at all, just as some of the best comics actually tell stories in different genres. A History of Violence might just be the perfect example of a comic book movie that doesn't make use of typical hero or villain tropes, as it's a tense crime thriller whose comic book origins aren't immediately obvious to those unaware of the source material. Directed by David Cronenberg, the 2005 movie featured an all-star cast led by Viggo Mortensen and William Hurt, and while the original comic is great, the movie is better — its two Oscar nominations attest to that. The reason it outshines the source material is pretty simple: the exceptional performances of its talented cast help give the characters greater depth, which in turn lends the story even more emotional and thematic weight. It's not a case of the movie making any huge innovations, but rather an example of a time when the translation from one medium to the next simply elevated the story's potential, resulting in the movie seeming even better than the already incredible source material.

While it might not always be recognized as such, 1994's The Crow is one of the most influential superhero movies outside of the Marvel and DC spheres. The film was adapted from the comic book series of the same name, which was created by James O'Barr and first published in 1989. The movie adaptation starring Brandon Lee is much better known than the source material, although that reputation partly stems from the tragic circumstances surrounding its production. However, it's an exceptional comic book movie in its own right, and another that managed to improve upon the comic it was based upon. The movie adaptation of The Crow took the original story and built upon its mythology, establishing a unique visual identity that the comics could never have managed. The movie manages to balance the emotional story with a tragic romance, all framed by gothic production design and a great '90s soundtrack. There aren't many '90s comic book movies as iconic as The Crow , with its lasting legacy outlining how much it outshone its source material.

While there are many '90s comic book movies that are still talked about fondly today, 1994's The Mask is one that really stands out. Jim Carrey's hot streak continued with his starring role in this adaptation of the Dark Horse comic of the same name, although the movie approached the story in a very different way. The comic was a dark, violent, and horror-oriented story about a man transformed into a vengeful and sadistic superpowered being by the titular mask, but the movie took a more cartoonish and less sinister approach to the premise. By making Jim Carrey's Stanley Ipkiss more likeable and a reasonably heroic character, the movie delivered a story that quickly found mainstream success. Carrey's comic brilliance helped the movie massively, but by softening the dark edges of the original comic, 1994's The Mask managed to spawn an entire franchise including movie sequels and an animated TV show. As great as the original comics were, the movie managed to translate its story into something that was more fit for general audiences and, therefore, greater success.

Wanted might not be the best-known mid-00s comic book adaptation, but it has quietly cultivated for itself a reputation as one of the most underrated comic book movies from the 2000s. The 2008 film starring James McAvoy, Angelina Jolie, and Morgan Freeman was loosely based on the miniseries of the same name by Mark Millar and J. G. Jones, and follows a seemingly unremarkable young man as he is inducted into a secret society of assassins known as the Fraternity. Whereas the comics explicitly state that the Fraternity is a society of supervillains, the movie takes a more neutral stance, allowing McAvoy and Jolie's performances to bring more depth to the characters. The result is a story that resonates much more than that of the source material, and naturally, its action sequences feel so much more exciting on the big screen. By adapting the Wanted comics into a fast-paced action thriller with several bankable stars, the movie turned out to be a far better version of the story than the source material, even if it has become criminally underrated in the years since its release.

articles.title: Willa, Women Make Movies Team to Release Shalini Kantayya’s Doc ‘Love Apptually’ Theatrically
articles.summary: Willa and Women Make Movies have teamed up to distribute documentary “Love Apptually,” theatrically in the U.S. Set for a February released timed to Valentine’s Day, “Love Apptually,” directed by Shalini Kantayya, follows French journalist Judith Duportail's journey from her early fascination with Tinder to an investigation into the technologies and business incentives mediating our […]
articles.content:
Willa and Women Make Movies have teamed up to distribute documentary “ Love Apptually ,” theatrically in the U.S. Set for a February released timed to Valentine’s Day, “Love Apptually,” directed by Shalini Kantayya, follows French journalist Judith Duportail's journey from her early fascination with Tinder to an investigation into the technologies and business incentives mediating our search for human connection. After uncovering Tinder's hidden desirability rating system, Duportail demanded access to her personal data, ultimately receiving 800 pages of information collected by the platform. What begins as a personal curiosity evolves into a global investigation into how a multi-billion-dollar tech industry is quietly reshaping desire, intimacy and love. Kantayya digs into how dating platforms are designed to maximize engagement and profit, often at the expense of authentic human connection. The film raises questions about agency, autonomy, privacy, and the commercialization of human intimacy. “I’ve watched Big Tech move from capturing our attention to shaping our most intimate human relationships. ‘Love Apptually’ asks whether the loneliness epidemic is a consequence of technological design,” said director Shalini Kantayya. The film bowed at Hot Docs and also recently screened at DOC NYC. “Love Apptually” marks the final installment in Kantayya's trilogy examining technology's impact on human experience, following “Coded Bias” and “TikTok, Boom.,” which both premiered at Sundance, screened on PBS’s Independent Lens and received Emmy nominations. “Valentine’s Day is a time when we celebrate love, but ‘Love Apptually’ asks us to look more closely at the forces shaping how we find it,” said Elizabeth Woodward, founder and CEO of Willa and producer of the film. “Shalini has created a film that reveals how technology has moved beyond capturing our attention to influencing our most intimate relationships. We're excited to bring the film to audiences at a moment when these conversations feel particularly meaningful, and to use the theatrical experience as an opportunity to reconnect, reflect, and rethink what it means to find love in the digital age.” “We have worked with Shalini Kantayya since her first film, ‘A Drop of Life,’ and we were proud to support ‘Love Apptually’ through our Production Assistance Program,” says Debra Zimmerman, executive director of Women Make Movies. “After the phenomenal success and tremendous impact of ‘Coded Bias,’ including screenings with decision makers at major technology companies, we’re eager to work with Willa to help audiences everywhere see the film and continue these conversations.” Related Stories 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' First Reactions Call Prequel the 'Rogue One' of the Franchise and Praise Joseph Zada as Haymitch 'X-Men': 'Hunger Games' Actor Ben Wang Circling Iceman Role in Marvel's Reboot

‘Love Apptually’ is a 7th Empire Media production, presented by Willa in association with Minderoo Pictures and the Concordia Fellowship, with support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation and the Perspective Fund. The film is produced by Kantayya and Woodward. articles.title: Marvel Just Reimagined Doctor Octopus in the Most Disturbing Way Possible
articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Marvel Comics Doctor Octopus is rightfully recognized as one of Spider-Man’s most powerful, intelligent, and iconic villains. Now that Marvel Comics has introduced the horror-themed Midnight Universe, it has begun to craft the most disturbing reimaginings of the Wall-Crawler and his rogues’ gallery. Spider-Man himself has gone from a witty, colorful hero to an abomination of mad […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Doctor Octopus is rightfully recognized as one of Spider-Man’s most powerful, intelligent, and iconic villains. Now that Marvel Comics has introduced the horror-themed Midnight Universe, it has begun to craft the most disturbing reimaginings of the Wall-Crawler and his rogues’ gallery. Spider-Man himself has gone from a witty, colorful hero to an abomination of mad science, with a mutated spider merged onto his chest. And if that’s how Marvel depicts its most beloved hero, then his villains are bound to be even more terrifying. Nowhere is that clearer than with the release of Midnight Spider-Man 's second issue and the debut of Midnight Doctor Octopus.

Doctor Octopus and Spider-Man have one of the most heated rivalries in Marvel Comics. The Web-Slinger is frequently confronting the mad scientist and his evil plans. Meanwhile, in the Midnight Universe, Doc Ock is not only set up as the first big bad that Spider-Man must face, but he’s responsible for the hero’s newfound powers. And to top it all off, Marvel has reimagined Doc Ock’s most iconic feature to make him an absolute monster.

Whenever people think of Doctor Octopus, their first thought is always the weapons that provide him his namesake. These are the four giant mechanical tentacles permanently fused to Doc Ock’s body which give him the strength and agility to match Spider-Man. His tentacles combined with his brain power make Doc Oct both an intellectual and physical threat to Peter. However, Midnight Spider-Man #2, titled “The Eight-Handed Man,” gives us the most disturbing and creative reimagining of the villain’s signature appendages to date.

In the Midnight Universe, Dr. Otto Octavius is a lead researcher at Oscorp and a supervisor of the Augustine Project. This project indirectly led to a random spider being pumped full of radiation and drugs which then sneaked its way into Peter’s backpack and merged with him. When Felicia Hardy, an Oscorp employee, is brought to Octavius’ lab, we see the Midnight Universe’s incarnation of Doc Ock. Instead of four mechanical arms, Octavius uses brain implants to puppeteer four people whose humanity and individuality have been stripped away through cybernetics. These four cyborg servants collectively act as Octavius’ eight arms when conducting his inhuman experiments. Octavius even threatens to add Felicia to his collection of cyberized slaves if she fails him.

The concept behind Midnight Doctor Octopus is unbelievably creepy: he bends the minds of these innocent people to his will and uses them as tools. Superior Spider-Man already showed that the regular Doc Ock can hijack other people’s minds, but his Midnight incarnation is on another level. Few other versions of Doc Ock have come even close to that level of cruelty. Doc Ock has always been a villain whose greatest weapon is his intellect and seeing him use it to directly control others shows his utter lack of empathy. These cyborgs are also likely heavily armed, ensuring they’ll be an organized, deadly fighting force against Spider-Man. All this together makes Doctor Octopus one of the most powerful and threatening villains Midnight Spider-Man could face.

The basic premise of Midnight Spider-Man is that after Peter is mutated by the spider, he must desperately try to resist the creature’s feral influence. Overall, the story is one of control as Spider-Man frantically tries to avoid becoming a monster . Midnight Spider-Man #2 already shows that this goal is an uphill battle, as Peter savagely rips apart Oscorp goons without a shred of remorse or sanity. Doctor Octopus and his servants represent Spider-Man’s ultimate fear: losing his humanity and control over his own body and mind to a malevolent corporation.

Now that Octavius and the rest of Oscorp know that Peter is alive and mutated by the spider, they will do everything in their power to capture him. They’ll undoubtedly send all manner of mercenaries and monstrosities to hunt down Peter and bring him to Oscorp’s lab for experimentation and possible weaponization. And with a being as powerful as Spider-Man out on the loose, Octavius will defiantly want to add the Wall-Crawler to his collection of cyborg servants. So not only will Peter have to wrestle control from the monster within, but he also will have to deal with Octavius trying to lobotomize and brainwash him as well. Essentially, Doc Ock personifies Oscorp’s desire to dominate everything and everyone.

In just two issues, Midnight Spider-Man has delivered one of the most nightmare-inducing incarnations of both the Wall-Crawler and one of his most hated enemies. Midnight Doctor Octopus shows how corporations like Oscorp can strip employees of their freedoms and individuality, turning them into corporate zombies who blindly follow their superiors. With Oscorp set up as the overarching villain of the Midnight Spider-Man series, Peter must do everything in his power to stop Octavius from taking what little humanity he has left and turning him into the company’s ultimate monster.

articles.content:
EXCLUSIVE: In 2023, Warner Bros. and Amy Pascal snatched up rights to a Theo Baker bestseller, How to Rule the World : An Education in Power at Stanford University , in a competitive auction. We broke that story, and now, we can tell you that the project has a director in Sean Wang , the Oscar nominee and Independent Spirit Award winner behind Focus Features' Dìdi .

Wang and Matthew Libby are adapting the screenplay, with Pascal and Rachel O'Connor set to produce for Pascal Pictures.

Published in May, Baker's How to Rule the World is both a coming-of-age memoir and a critique of some of our most powerful institutions. The book recounts his freshman year at Stanford, when the aspiring coder wound up working on investigative reporting as part of the student newspaper. He later earned a Directors Guild of America nomination for Outstanding Directorial Achievement of a First-Time Theatrical Feature Film, while Dìdi won Independent Spirit Awards for Best First Feature and Best First Screenplay. articles.title: I Didn’t Expect Jennifer Love Hewitt’s Intense Take On Reuniting With Ryan Phillippe For 9-1-1
articles.summary: The reunion brought the heat to 9-1-1.
articles.content:
The 9-1-1 franchise is heating up amid the 2026 TV schedule . While the fall finales of both the Mothership and 9-1-1: Nashville air this week, there's going to be a lot more on the way in the new year. This includes a much-anticipated I Know What You Did Last Summer reunion between Jennifer Love Hewitt and Ryan Phillippe . I'm excited, but what I didn’t expect was Hewitt’s intense take on working with her former co-star again.

Following speculation that Phillippe and Hewitt would be reuniting , Hewitt recently confirmed that he would indeed guest star on 9-1-1 , reprising his Nashville role as Detective Rogue Kelly. Surprisingly, this is actually the first time that they’ve seen each other since filming wrapped on IKWYDLS , and Hewitt recalled to People just what the atmosphere felt like before the crossover came together. And her take even makes me a bit anxious:

I love that even though they’ve worked together before, Hewitt can still have those nerves, and I can’t say I blame her. Reuniting with someone you haven’t seen in years -- even if it's on your own turf -- can be intimidating. It sounds like the mood instantly shifted when Phillippe came to set, in a good way, and it makes me even more excited to see how it all turns out.

As for right now, details surrounding the next 9-1-1 and 9-1-1: Nashville crossover have not been revealed, and I'm eager to see what brings Rogue to Los Angeles. After trying to track down a serial killer in Nashville who is using biblical plagues, hopefully this trip out West will be a bit lighter for him. articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google The magical world of Disney is days away from becoming a little more enchanted, as Hexed is set to arrive in theaters on Thanksgiving Eve, Nov. 25, 2026. With an all-star cast that includes Hailee Steinfeld, Jodie Foster, Walton Goggins , Rashida Jones and even Henry Winkler making his long-awaited return to a Disney property, all eyes (of newt) are cast on this animated feature about a teenage girl transported from her ho-hum everyday life into a school for witches. If that sounds familiar, you wouldn't be wrong, as this concept is drawing comparisons to other popular franchises like Harry Potter and Wicked .

During an interview with ComicBook's Chris Killian, co-directors Jason Hand and Fawn Veerasunthorn answered a question that many people have been wondering for some time now, and that's how this movie will fit with fans of other magical franchises. It's admittedly difficult to fight the upstream battle against established wizarding schools and other magical academies, but that knowledge of other fandoms is something that both Hand and Veerasunthorn kept in the back of their minds while formulating their universe, making it something highly different and a little unexpected from what fans of this style of film are used to watching.

In order to be the best institution of supernatural arts, one must know their competition. Hand and Veerasunthorn did their homework and looked at what other places were doing, and figured out how to keep their universe wholly separate while also turning the genre upside down to give it their own flair. That process starts with looking at where Hexed's magic originates from and designing abilities around it that are fun, friendly and easy to understand.

"We have our own magic system that ties to nature. The three ‘I’s, intention, ignition, in-witchification," Veerasunthorn explained with a smile. "That's like a first step of learning magic. We love that because we want people to enter the world of Hexed and feel like we're learning with Billy, we discover this world of magic with Billy. Billy might have read and watched all those movies and books you mentioned, and she might have had her own perception of what it should be. And we're like, you have that. We're gonna twist it all."

"I think we take that and add a huge dollop of weird things," Hand added to the discussion. "There's a lot of weird stuff in this movie, and I'm not joking. So I think the level of specificity to a character like Beef Roger, even the enchanted characters like are the talking book and the quill, like, that's the kind of stuff that really separates it from anything else that's out there. So I think we have so much fun with all of those pieces, and then just keep adding all kinds of craziness to it, like the dark stuff that you said. That is just fun for us. Like we chased our fancy in this one and had a lot of fun doing it."

Disney has dabbled in magic through other films, with a recent popular entry being the Frozen franchise. Hexed will be their attempt at breaking into the crowded magical academy segment of entertainment, and the studio has made sure they're doing everything they can to mark the occasion. Audiences who see the movie in theaters will be treated to a new Lilo & Stitch short that introduces a new feline character , offering a bonus cartoon for added value to this Disney original.

On a sadder note, Hexed may also be the last animated film that utilizes the current cartoon style that has been popular with so many of Disney's films for the past few years. How the future will look remains to be seen, but for now Hexed plans to add something bewitching to its library of films that will hopefully cast a spell on many viewers.

Will you be watching Hexed in theaters when it arrives on Nov. 25, or will you wait for it to be streaming or skip it entirely? Join the conversation in the comments and let us know how you feel about this upcoming Disney film.

articles.title: GTA 6 - When Can You Get a New Car?
articles.summary: One of the biggest changes that Rockstar Games has made with Grand Theft Auto 6 is tied to its vehicles. While you can still hijack just about every car, truck, boat, helicopter, and plane that you see in the game, Rockstar has put a much greater emphasis on giving Jason and Lucia their own unique […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google One of the biggest changes that Rockstar Games has made with Grand Theft Auto 6 is tied to its vehicles. While you can still hijack just about every car, truck, boat, helicopter, and plane that you see in the game, Rockstar has put a much greater emphasis on giving Jason and Lucia their own unique rides that they're able to personalize and upgrade. This system is more in line with the one that Rockstar introduced in Red Dead Redemption 2 , as protagonist Arthur Morgan could develop a bond with his horse, while also using it for additional storage.

When you begin GTA 6 , Jason will already have his own vehicle of choice: the Vapid Ganado. This inaugural car is the one that Jason will be primarily driving through the game's earliest hours in the Leonida Keys. However, when you get deeper into Grand Theft Auto 6 , you'll finally be able to shift away from the Ganado and select a new car to become your default ride. To that end, if you're wondering when this feature becomes available, we have the full breakdown.

Throughout the entirety of Chapter 1 of Grand Theft Auto 6 , you'll be locked into using Jason's Ganado. While you can take it to a local auto shop to repair any broken parts or give it a fresh coat of paint, you're not able to register a new vehicle outright. This won't prevent you from hijacking any other cars you might find out in the open-world, but none of these vehicles you pick up will be permanently registered as in your custody.

Once you get in Chapter 2, though, this finally changes. In one of the first story missions in Chapter 2, Lucia meets Moses, who is a mechanic who runs a car shop. While you can sell stolen vehicles to Moses to help bring in a bit more money, you can also bring him any car you find out in the world to register as your own. Doing so can occasionally cost a fair bit of money, so you'll want to ensure that you have enough funds in order to do this before you pay Moses a visit. Once you do, though, you'll permanently be able to keep this same car unless you decide to swap it out or sell it.

Even after you gain access to registering vehicles in GTA 6 , many of the higher-end, more sought-after vehicles in the game will remain unable to be acquired. The reason for this is simply because almost all of the supercars in Grand Theft Auto 6 happen to come with trackers. The advanced trackers, in particular, are difficult to remove and cannot be taken off these cars by Moses or other Pay n Spray shops around Leonida until later. Because of this, even if you happen to see a sleek supercar that drives by you on the streets of Vice City, chances are you won't be able to register it even if you did happen to steal it.

Still, don't fret, as Grand Theft Auto 6's story eventually puts you in control of vehicles like this the deeper that you get into it. While you might have to start out the game by driving broken-down trucks or other vehicles released near the turn of the century, you'll eventually be able to get your hands on some truly exciting cars that will have you flying down the highway at well over 100mph. To that end, just keep making progress in GTA 6's main missions if you want to unlock these cars sooner rather than later.

articles.title: Robert Pattinson Allegedly Got A Big Payday Just For Auditioning For Bond (And More Money Is On The Way)

articles.content:
After considerable speculation and a plethora of reports, it was finally confirmed this week that Robert Pattinson would take on the mantle of James Bond . I personally didn’t have my money on the Batman actor trading in his cape for a suit, but I'm not mad at it! Now, additional details are starting to reach the surface, as it's been alleged that Pattinson was pulled into an audition after executives were struggling to make a decision. Pattinson -- who has since been congratulated by the British Royal Family and more -- the Royal Family welcomed him as the next Bond. Again, none of this is confirmed, but such a paycheck would make sense, given the deal and the sheer size of this storied IP.

Details on Bond 26 are being kept under wraps, including the title and premise. At this point, it also feels unlikely that it'll be released in 2027. However, we do know that Denis Villeneuve will be directing the movie, meaning this will be a Dune reunion for him and Pattinson. There is a lot of speculation surrounding who will join Pattinson, as names are being thrown out for the next Bond villain. And, of course, many are wondering who will be the next Bond girl with rumors placing Margaret Qualley in the lead as a strong candidate.

Florence Pugh is speaking out about recent conversations that have emerged online about her body, pertaining to speculation that she's had surgery and is on Ozempic.

The East of Eden star took to Instagram on Wednesday, writing that she finds it "so stressful waking up and have thousands of people talking about you and your body in ways that you can’t even comprehend. I’m aware that the culture on socials currently is very interested in talking about people's surgery and ozempic changes, it’s clearly a part of our time right now, that there’s this frenzy of people picking apart what’s truth and what’s fake." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories News Carrie Coon Calls for Women to Start Their Own Studio as Elle Women in Hollywood Honorees Push for Change Movies Florence Pugh Celebrates Robert Pattinson's Bond Casting: "He's Been the No. 1 Vote in My Household"

articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google 2026 marks the 10th anniversary of the manga debut of Demon Slayer , a Weekly Shonen Jump hit written and illustrated by Koyoharu Gotouge. The series has been on the rise of popular ever since then, but things took a drastic turn after the anime debut by Ufotable in 2019. Fans immediately fell in love with the striking visuals and a lovable protagonist. While the anime is currently in its final stretch, the manga wrapped up its story in 2020 with no hopes of a return with a spin-off or a sequel . Following the conclusion of the Hashira Training Arc in the anime, Ufotable confirmed that the Infinity Castle Arc will be adapted in a trilogy of movies.

The first installment has already been released, while fans await updates on Part 2 . Ever since the anime debuted in 2019, this year is the first time Demon Slayer hasn't released a new TV season or a movie. Considering the animation quality and the exceptional adaptation, it's only fair that the studio takes as much time as it needs for another movie. However, the biggest problem wasn't the lack of a new release for the anime's continuation but the fact that Demon Slayer didn't even celebrate its 10th anniversary.

For a globally popular series like Demon Slayer , the manga's 10th anniversary is a pretty huge deal. Even if the anime couldn't return with a new movie this year, fans should've gotten new updates for the anniversary or a celebratory message from the creator. This is especially disappointing considering how most series usually make a big deal of the anniversary celebrations. Whether it's new visuals, merchandise, or even anime or manga projects, fans often get all kinds of new updates to commemorate major milestones. 2026 is almost over, and the anniversary during February was pretty dull. There's still a possibility that the series will drop new information during this year's Jump Festa .

Along with a majority of the Shonen Jump hits, Demon Slayer is expected to drop new information during the convention. It will hold a panel on the Super Stage, along with some of the biggest hits of all time, including One Piece and Naruto . Jump Festa 2027 will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026 , but it has yet to drop the entire schedule. While it's almost certain fans can expect updates on the Infinity Castle Part 2, there is a slight possibility of new projects being announced for the anniversary. Rumors have been circulating that the next movie will be released next year, but nothing can be certain without an official announcement. Additionally, even if Demon Slayer shared anniversary updates by the end of the year, it can't erase the disappointment, especially since it should've been done almost a year ago.

Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler finally gets his chance in the Marvel spotlight . These days, Cumming is best known for speaking in his natural Scottish accent as the host of The Traitors , manipulating players with dramatic pronouncements and surprise reveals. In 2003, however, he was a mutant superhero with a German accent on the big screen. The second X-Men film, X2: X-Men United , debuted Cumming as Nightcrawler, a fan favorite from the comics, and absolutely the best character to play in the side-scrolling X-Men arcade game thanks to his agility. The early aughts being what they were, he didn't really have a comic-book costume, but rather a more realistic long coat and street clothes — the blue skin and tattoos made the point that he was a mutant.

Cumming's coming back for Avengers: Doomsday , and now that it's in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, there's less of an allergy to costumes that look right. For continuity, he does still have a long coat, but now it has a big X logo on it, while his purple duds underneath evoke the comics' black and red design; also, as we've seen before, he now has the signature pirate sword that always came packed in with all his action figures. Check out the best look at him yet from Doomsday , on a new poster with M'Baku:

Considering how popular Cumming's turn as Nightcrawler was, it's strange to think he was only previously in one movie across the franchise. That's partly because the character relies on heavy makeup and special effects to do his teleporting powers justice; as such, he was cut from earlier drafts of both the first X-Men and Days of Future Past . By the time the essential CG got cheaper, the series was rebooting, so Kodi Smit-McPhee played a younger version of the character in Apocalypse and Dark Phoenix , as well as being part of the quick team cameo in Deadpool 2 .

One thing we know about Nightcrawler in Doomsday is that he's going to be in a lot of effects-heavy sequences. Cumming has previously mentioned that much of the time, due to secrecy and green screens, he mainly just hit his marks without necessarily knowing what was supposed to be happening or even who he'd be in a scene with. For once, it's his turn to be the disoriented pawn in a larger game for everyone's entertainment. The actor's not as spry as he once was, but part of the point of including the Fox X-Men characters, it seems, is to show them aging, near the end of their lives.

All that said, Cumming has added that he had much more fun this time around . The improved makeup and visual effects were far less uncomfortable, and the Russo brothers were easier directors than the now-notorious and controversial Bryan Singer. Getting to do stunts in his 60s was also fun for him — no injuries have been reported, so he evidently pulled them off. Fans should be equally happy to see him back — Cumming is an actor of considerable range who can do much more than name traitors.

How do you like the new look of Nightcrawler in this poster? BAMF down into comments and let us know.

articles.title: New Avengers: Doomsday Footage May Have Confirmed a Massive Rumor About the Opening Scene
articles.summary: Marvel Studios There is only one month left until the opening of Avengers: Doomsday (at the time of writing this), and the promotional campaign for the film is kicking into high gear. The latest promotional spot features Robert Downey Jr. talking about what it has been like returning to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Doctor Doom. The […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google There is only one month left until the opening of Avengers: Doomsday (at the time of writing this), and the promotional campaign for the film is kicking into high gear. The latest promotional spot features Robert Downey Jr. talking about what it has been like returning to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Doctor Doom. The promo features Downey sitting in an empty movie theater, ruminating on his thoughts, while some footage from Doomsday is spliced into the video.

One quick shot from the footage definitely caught our eye: the sight of one specific location that may be the biggest piece of evidence yet that a longstanding rumor about Doomsday 's opening sequence may indeed be true. And if it is, then it will be the darkest opening for an Avengers movie yet.

There's one scene in the new Avengers: Doomsday footage that has been given a much bigger visual punch: a city landscape that is clearly New York City, only it looks like the entire city is being dusted by Thanos and is crumbling to dust. Thanks to the clearer visuals, we can see that this is the familiar incursion effect that we've seen in films like Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. But which version of NYC are we seeing meet its end? That's where some Avengers: Doomsday theory comes into play.

One early "leak" about Avengers: Doomsday 's plot was how the film would open. It was rumored that the opening sequence would be a final battle on Earth-96283, the world where Sam Riaim's Spider-Man trilogy takes place. There have been conflicting versions of how it goes down, but the general gist of it is that Tobey Maguire's Spider-Man will desperately be trying to stop the incursion that will destroy his world. Deadpool (Tobey Maguire) and Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) are supposedly involved in the scene, as Spider-Man's world finally meets its end.

The leaks also disagree about how the sequence will end: One version is that Maguire's Spider-Man is whisked away to safety via a Time Variance Authority portal, setting Tobey's Spider-Man up for a whole different battle sequence that has also been hinted to take place midway through the movie . The other version of the leak says Maguire's Spider-Man dies battling Wolverine and Deadpool , as the X-Men take out one competing universe, and then set their sights on the Avengers' world (Earth-616).

So is this the Sam Raimi Spider-Man version of New York we're seeing in Avengers: Doomsday ? Proving that will be hard before we get to the final cut of the film, but the Central Park location and surrounding buildings seem pretty familiar. There's always the possibility that we could be seeing NYC from the Avengers' world (Earth-616) or the X-Men's world (Earth-10005), but both seem like they would be major twists in the film that Marvel wouldn't even play around with spoiling in trailers. Teasing the end of Earth-96283 is far less risky, while still compelling to the average viewer.

Avengers: Doomsday will be released in theaters on December 18th. Do you think that's Raimi's NYC that's being destroyed?

articles.title: Kylie Cantrall Surprises Fans With Private Acoustic Set in Downtown L.A.
articles.summary: The actress-singer, who broke out with her role as Red in Disney's 'Descendants' movies, took over Moxy Downtown Los Angeles to perform for fans on Tuesday night.
articles.content:
On the heels of her Valley Girl Problems Tour, Kylie Cantrall played a surprise intimate acoustic set in downtown Los Angeles on Tuesday night for a crowd of enthusiastic fans who sang along with all of her tunes.

Cantrall took over Moxy Downtown Los Angeles for the special event, which also celebrated her EP, Valley Girl Problems, which debuted in July. The event was part of Moxy Hotels’ ongoing music series, which brings emerging and buzzy artists together with fans for intimate experiences at Moxy properties around the world (other recent events have featured Ayra Starr in the U.K.). blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Music Mumford & Sons' Ben Lovett to Open New Venue At Brooklyn's Domino Sugar Refinery Lifestyle Kel Mitchell Bringing 'Kel's Burger Fest' to Los Angeles: "It's a Full-On Burger Bonanza"

The actor-singer — who has starred in two of Disney's Descendants movies, playing Red, daughter of the Queen of Hearts — noted onstage that Los Angeles was her hometown and she was "feeling the love" at Moxy DTLA that night.

After asking how many people were also at her recent tour — many in the audience were — she shared: "That show was a mix of emotions. I was so sad," she said, and then a fan said she had cried during the show. "I made you cry? That should be a disclaimer on my website: If you're coming to a Kylie show, there's a chance you're going to cry. But you're going to shake a little ass too," she quipped. "It's a mix of both. That's me in a nutshell honestly — crying and shaking ass at the same time."

Cantrall said she was missing being on tour when Moxy Hotels reached out about the surprise pop-up L.A. show, and she said jumped at the chance to perform in the intimate venue. Addressing the fans, she continued, "Thank you guys for coming at the last minute." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

She performed four songs at the event, kicking off with "Carrie Bradshaw," a tribute to Cantrall's "favorite TV character," the one played by Sarah Jessica Parker in Sex and the City. "She's is a fashion icon; she's kind of a mess as well, but we love her for it," Cantrall said. (The bar at Moxy DTLA was serving special cocktails in honor of the event that included the Carrie Cosmo and the Valley Girl Martini.)

Next up was "Oversized," from her previous EP, B.O.Y. (Deluxe). She revealed that she's a "hoodie stealer," joking that she had about five of her best friend's hoodies at her house. In co-writing the song, "I was kind of inspired by this era I was in, dating and dealing with guys with hoodies. … I definitely still have two of (my ex's) hoodies that I never gave back, but he never asked for them back. And they look better on me anyway," she joked.

"You know we're gonna get in our feels for a minute," she said, introducing the next song, the emotional "Space Between" from Valley Girl Problems. "Now that I've been home, I've been writing the next album … but I haven't written any ballads on it so far. That just goes to show you we're healed. We're healing slowly day by day. This song is very special to me. If you're going through something right now, or maybe you're healing through a situation, maybe even this song helped you heal a little bit." After, a fan told her that song always makes her cry, to which Cantrall responded that it makes her emotional as well. She also gave the crowd a note of encouragement: "You are so entitled to feeling whatever you're feeling … and I think the best thing we can do as humans is just try to embrace our imperfections and let that shit go, whether it's writing it down, talking to someone, therapy, writing music, creating art. … You are never alone." (Here she quipped that it was her first 18-and-older show, so she didn't have to censor herself as when she was on tour.) blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-thr-article-mid-articleX-uid2' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["btf","mid-articleX","mid"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-articleX") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setLazyLoadMultiplier(2) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Cantrall closed the show with "Elastic," which she said was so frequently requested during her tour that she wound up adding it to her setlist. She wrapped with an a capella sing-along to a few verses of "Valley Girl Problems" to the delight of those inside Moxy DTLA.

Indeed, many of those in attendance sang along with her songs throughout the performance, and Cantrall engaged in some fun banter with the fans. Afterward, she asked the crowd to take a group photo before graciously signing autographs and taking selfies with fans' phones.

Cantrall recently hit 15 cities across North America as part of her first-ever headlining tour, which kicked off Sept. 25 in Minneapolis and wrapped up Oct. 22 in Los Angeles, her hometown. Next, she's set to appear on three dates of the Jingle Ball tour (Dec. 1 in Dallas, Dec. 14 in Washington, D.C. and Dec. 15 in Philadelphia). In summer 2025, she toured North America as part of Disney's Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour.

Valley Girl Problems, released via Republic Records, follows on the heels of her debut EP, B.O.Y. The new nine-track EP was produced by Grammy-winning hitmaker Tricky Stewart (Rihanna, Tyla) and written alongside acclaimed songwriter Tayla Parx.

Moxy Hotels says that its music series aims to create a space where Gen Z can be connected with artists, events and moments shaping culture.

articles.content:
Everyone has a music lover in their life, and the holidays are the perfect time to get them something special, whether it’s a record player, a CD box set, a nice pair of headphones or some earplugs to protect their hearing at concerts.

Variety has curated this list of the best music books, home stereo systems and personal listening devices — as well as instruments and gear for both beginners and veteran musicians — so you can surprise your audiophile friend or guitar-playing relative with the perfect present this holiday season. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-variety-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Noel Clarke Trial Set for 2027 Over Alleged Sex Offenses ‘Ginny & Georgia’ Sets Season 4 Release Date, Drops First Look Photos

While Squier is Fender’s entry-level guitar line, it feels slightly unfair to call one a “beginner guitar” considering its quality. In the Squier Classic Vibe Series, Fender has expanded its collection of vintage-inspired designs at an affordable price, with Stratocasters, Jaguars and two limited-edition Telecasters . The guitars come in all sorts of colors, from Fiesta Red to White Blonde to Lake Placid Blue. This guitar is the perfect gift for a new shredder who is serious about upping their game.

For the serious musician, touring guitarist or passionate hobbyist looking for a more substantial product, the Fender New American Professional is a sleek, sexy and strong piece of hardware. The Telecasters have a comfortable, flexible bridge and single-coil pickups that deliver the snappy twang synonymous with the brand. Plus, it comes with a Deluxe Molded hardshell case for taking music on the go.

For musicians who wish to record music on the go, the Fender AudioBox Go is a basic interface that lets you plug in and set up anywhere. It may not be as dynamic as higher-tech options, like the classic Focusrite Scarlett 2i2, but it’s more compact and — at its low price point — offers everything a beginner will need for laying down audio tracks. Each purchase also comes with a six-month Fender Studio Pro trial.

Be the life of the party with the Akai Numark Party Mix III, a Bluetooth DJ controller with stems control and a beat-synced LED light show. Beginner DJs can learn how to mix tracks and pump up the jams from their phone or tablet.

Chances are you’ve heard a Shure SM7 without knowing it: on the radio or even on your favorite podcast. It’s the industry standard mic that makes voices sound rich, warm and close. The SM7dB is the newest and most headache-free version. Its built-in booster makes it sound great plugged into a simple home setup, and a couple of switches let you fine-tune the tone. For the friend starting a podcast or recording the next great American album, this mic is an upgrade they’ll hear instantly.

A simple sound bar can work wonders on a home television setup. Yamaha’s brand new B200A, perfect for sound enhancement in TV, gaming and music streaming, features a built-in subwoofer and Dolby Atmos. You’ll never complain again about not being able to hear the dialogue in your favorite show. Check out Variety’s home theater awards with more soundbar and audio options here .

For those looking to further optimize the sound in their living rooms or home theaters, Yamaha’s RX300A AV receiver is an intuitive system that serves as a flexible hub for all sorts of speaker layouts. With an easy setup, you can tailor immersive audio to any space at home.

A wireless smart speaker with built-in Dolby Atmos, the Denon Home 600 is a powerful, standalone stereo device for the home. It’s for casual music listeners and audiophiles looking for one speaker with built-in subwoofers and an eight-driver array creating a three-dimensional, immersive sound. If this price point is too high, Denon also makes two smaller models, the 200 and the 400.

Turn your living room into a full-fledged home theater with Sony’s Bravia Theater Trio, all you need to create a simple surround-sound experience at home. The three-speaker design works best with large televisions, and the product was created in collaboration with Sony Pictures Entertainment so the sound lives up to the blockbuster standard of today’s filmmakers. With the Bravia Connect app, the system can be calibrated and controlled from your smartphone.

For the new guitar player who hasn’t quite found their desired feel, this Tortex Variety Pack comes with 12 picks across six different gauges. The matte surface makes them easy to grip, and the bright colors will make any guitarist stand out.

As far as high-end headphones go, the Bowers & Wilkins Px8 S2 are top of the line. They’re sleek and comfortable, and the sound quality is excellent. These premium headphones are made in four color options, and they come with a flat, zipper case for portability. With excellent noise cancellation, the Px8 S2s are perfect for flying.

For the person in your life who has been collecting records for years but still sticks to streaming, this fully automatic, analog turntable from Denon is a great introduction to playing vinyl. It has an easy, two-button setup and premium sound quality. And it features a built-in phono pre-amp, meaning it can plug directly into speakers or a stereo without extra gear. Check out more of the best record players to shop this year here .

These Pioneer speakers can help upgrade your DJ setup or even just your home office. These compact 4-inch monitors can pair over Bluetooth for everyday listening, or plug into a mixer when it’s time to light up the party. Sleek enough for a dorm or living room, and available in white too, the DM-40D-BTs are a gift that gets cranked up the day they’re unwrapped.

Do you know someone who can’t stop talking about their guitar? Or someone who can’t seem to ever find their keys? Well, if those happen to be the same person, the Fender Jack Rack is the perfect household accessory. The wall-mounted key holder is a pint-sized replica of a classic Fender amp — it looks and feels exactly like one, with four input jacks across the front. And it comes with four quarter-inch-cable keychains, so you can plug in every time you get home.

The only downside to being a concert junkie is the morning-after ring. Most music fans don’t want to dilute the sound of live music with crappy foam earplugs, and custom plugs can be quite expensive. The Loop Experience 2 earplugs have an acoustic channel and mesh filter that turn the volume down by 17 dB while keeping the music clear. Plus, they’re shaped like jewelry and come in a variety of colors. For those with a front-row habit who are conscious about their hearing, the Loops are a perfect and affordable gift.

Long before you could play a synth on your smartphone, there was the Stylophone: a palm-sized instrument you play by touching a brass-tipped stylus to a metal keyboard. Invented in 1967, it buzzed its way onto David Bowie’s “Space Oddity,” Kraftwerk’s “Pocket Calculator” and the White Stripes’ “Icky Thump.” This affordable reissue is faithful to the original instrument’s charming tone and offers a vibrato function. Anyone can find a melody in minutes, which makes it a perfect gift for seasoned musicians and total beginners alike.

A must-read classic for anyone interested in punk or rock — or a loved one who recently moved to New York — “Just Kids” chronicles Patti Smith’s young adulthood in Manhattan, when she met and fell in love with the artist Robert Mapplethorpe. It’s a music memoir, yes, but it’s more than that. Smith’s impeccable prose teems with possibility as she writes of friendship, music and growing up. It won the National Book Award in 2010. Check out more celebrity memoirs to shop here.

Often considered one of the best rock books ever written, “Trouble Boys” tells the exciting but often heartbreaking story of the Replacements, a band that should have been huge but did everything possible to make sure they weren’t. With access to its surviving members, author Bob Mehr wrote about the foundational alternative rock band behind “Can’t Hardly Wait” and “I Will Dare.” Behind the music, it’s a gripping story about brotherhood and self-sabotage.

In “Dilla Time: The Life and Afterlife of J Dilla, the Hip-Hop Producer Who Reinvented Rhythm,” Dan Charnas tells the story of the Detroit producer who changed hip-hop and died tragically at 32. This biography explains how J Dilla revolutionized rhythm itself and became one of the most influential beat makers of all time, a music titan who continues to loom large over his genre.

Bob Dylan’s Rolling Thunder Revue is one of the most famous tours in music history. Now you can listen to the live recordings from the second leg with this sprawling box set. Spread across 39 CDs are 22 performances from spring 1976, with 371 of its 381 tracks never before released. Dylan sounds explosive and raw, furnishing his most iconic songs with a full band including Mick Ronson, Scarlet Rivera and T Bone Burnett, with Joan Baez dropping in for duets. Shop more new vinyl releases here.

For the Tom Petty fanatic in your life, the “Origins” box set covers the rocker’s early years in the 1970s, when he and the Heartbreakers churned out some of the best rock songs of all time, like “American Girl” and “Breakdown.” The four-CD set includes 50th-anniversary editions of the band’s first two albums and a blistering 1977 set from the Record Plant, as well as a DVD of their 1978 Old Grey Whistle Test appearance, a Blu-ray of Atmos mixes and a 46-page fanzine.

The long-running comic book series Grendel is getting a TV series adaptation from Netflix .

The streamer announced the upcoming adult animation series on Wednesday as it revealed Widow’s Bay producer Bobak Esfarjani will showrun, write and executive produce.

Grendel , created by veteran comics artist and writer Matt Wagner, follows the author Hunter Rose, whose world is turned upside down after the murder of the woman he loves. But as he becomes the revenge-obsessed vigilante Grendel, he faces the choice of whether to return to a more normal life or become something closer to a villain than a hero. While Comico debuted the series in 1982, Dark Horse Comics has recently published the title. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Beyond the Book From Book Club to Netflix: How Katherine Center's 'The Bodyguard' Became 'Guarding Stars' Movies Lee Chang-dong on the Mysteries and Meaning of 'Possible Love'

“ Grendel has been at the forefront of independent comics for over forty years, and we’re thrilled to bring Matt Wagner’s creation to Netflix,” Netflix’s vp of animation series and kids and family John Derderian said in a statement. “Like the comic, this animated series will break the traditional superhero mold just as Matt's time-honored comic book has always done. Bobak, Dark Horse Entertainment and Bobbypills are bold storytellers who love this world as much as its fans do, and we’re so excited to partner with them to bring this story to screen.”

Netflix’s adaptation of the series will be executive produced by Chris Tongue, Tim Wiesch and Jay Komas for Dark Horse Entertainment as well as Lydia Antonini and Wagner. Bobbypills will serve as the studio.

articles.title: Newsmax Sues to Block Fox-Roku Deal
articles.summary: The right-wing cable channel pointed to the allegedly unusual way in which the Justice Department approved the deal, which catapults Fox into a major player in media and streaming.
articles.content:
Newsmax, the conservative cable news channel, has filed a lawsuit challenging Fox Corp.’s $22 billion acquisition of Roku , alleging the deal will undermine competition in free ad-supported streaming.

In a lawsuit filed on Wednesday in California federal court, Newsmax argues the merger will give Fox more than 70% of the market in violation antitrust laws. It targets the Justice Department's clearance of the acquisition with minimal concessions.

"DOJ virtually never clears a transaction combining the two leading competitors in a concentrated market; it typically demands divestiture of one or the other to protect competition," states the complaint. "In this case, however, DOJ allowed this merger to an effective monopoly to close unchallenged." blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Business Fox Agrees to Keep Roku Open to Rivals in Justice Department Greenlight Business Charlie Collier and Anjali Sud Exit Fox as New Digital Structure Set at Company

Fox closed the deal earlier this month, ahead of the 2027 target date identified by Fox executives. Hours after the announcement, the Justice Department issued a press release stating that it wouldn't sue to block the merger. It said that it concluded the deal is “not likely to result in harm to competition” in free ad-supported streaming.

Under the agreement with competition regulators, Fox will remain open to rivals. The company will continue carrying non-Fox movies and TV shows for at least three years, ensure competing services aren’t pushed down in search results or denied prominent placement on home screens and make audience data available to third parties. It also agreed to maintain safeguards preventing it from sharing sensitive information about rival content providers, including data on what users search for, watch and click until at least 2029. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Newsmax, which leans on The Roku Channel for the distribution of its news channel, reached out to Fox over concerns that the commitments obtained by the government had no mechanism ensuring compliance, according to the complaint. Fox was asked to sign an agreement making them enforceable, the lawsuit says, which was rejected.

"Far from alleviating the competitive concerns raised by the merger to monopoly between Fox and Roku, DOJ’s unusual press release – and Fox’s failure to stand by the commitments in that press release – underscores the need for judicial intervention," writes David Schwarz, a lawyer for Newsmax, in the filing.

The Justice Department typically negotiates consent decrees when it finds that a transaction will likely harm competition without concessions. The agreement is then released to the public and reviewed by the court, which ensures compliance with the merging companies' obligations. In this case, the government didn't appear to identify such a settlement.

In the lawsuit, Newsmax says the merger will substantially harm competition. The Roku Channel accounts for roughly 42% of all viewing time on free ad-supported services, with Tubi accounting for over 28%, according to Nielsen data. The 71% market share owned by the combined company should be presumptively anticompetitive under antitrust laws, the lawsuit claims.

The deal creates a new power player in media and streaming. Fox now owns two of the largest free streaming video platforms in Tubi and Roku, plus a premium streaming service in Fox One. And through Roku, it gains control of a behemoth distribution platform through which millions of households access TV, including applications operated by competitors like Netflix, YouTube and Disney+. Roku’s operating system powers its own streaming devices and is built into TVs. Its home screen is the gateway to those services for a significant chunk of the United States: Viewers use it to find apps, search for programming and, perhaps most important, decide what to watch. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-thr-article-mid-articleX-uid2' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["btf","mid-articleX","mid"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-articleX") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setLazyLoadMultiplier(2) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

Fox will have the ability to handicap rivals by giving its own services premium home-screen placement, steering viewers to its properties when they search for content and deprioritizing competitors in recommendation features, according to the complaint.

The megamerger had been more than a year in the making, though it closed in just five months.

articles.title: Angry Caregivers Are Using SNL’s Sister To Call Out Family Members On Social Media
articles.summary: One of the best SNL sketches in years is producing some strong reactions.
articles.content:
The goal of sharing a Saturday Night Live sketch is typically to elicit a laugh, but now and again, one makes such a thoughtful or important point that people use it as a conversation starter or as evidence to prove a point. That’s exactly what’s going on with last weekend’s Sister sketch , a fake commercial about how caregiving responsibilities overwhelmingly fall on the women in the family. Tens of thousands have taken to social media to share or retweet the sketch alongside comments about how they feel seen, and now, we’ve reached the point where people are using it to call out their own family members.

Actually, I probably phrased that second one too nicely. What many people are doing is throwing up their middle fingers at family members and telling stories about their avoidance and/ or woeful incompetence. Here’s a story with more than 69,000 likes …

That wild story is definitely not an outlier either. The angry rants are just pouring out of people, an overwhelming majority of whom are women who feel like they are left doing everything while their siblings live their lives. Some are mad about how they did everything until their parent died, only to find out their absentee sibling(s) got the exact same inheritance. Others are mad about how their family members infrequently show up and then critique the job they were doing and question the decisions they make.

Seriously, don’t take my word for it. Look wherever the Sister sketch is embedded. You’ll immediately start running into story after story of angry people who need to let it out. I saw one woman calling out the parent they’re looking after for raising her brother to think he didn’t need to help. I’ve seen numerous lawyers , nurses , dementia care workers and doctors saying they see the same dynamic over and over again. I saw one woman say her brother who lives near her mom can’t be bothered to help; so, she has to travel across the country to handle things.

It’s clear this sketch, which is filled with fun little easter eggs , struck a nerve, but it seems like in a very therapeutic way. It’s allowing people to give voice to frustrations they’ve clearly had for a long time, and if it leads to even some family members doing a little self-reflecting and helping out a bit more, it’ll be a huge victory. You can watch the sketch in full below...

Saturday Night Live is off for a few weeks for the holidays, but it’ll return in early December with the next new episode guest hosted by Amanda Seyfried . Fingers crossed she’s able to give us something that makes even a fraction of the cultural footprint. You can catch previously aired episodes streaming with a Peacock subscription .

articles.title: I Found Out Who Voiced Obsession’s One Wish Willow Guy (And Other Cool BTS Details)
articles.summary: I can't get enough of this movie.
articles.content:
Obsession is that one film on the 2026 movie schedule that we can’t stop talking about, and why would we want to? Now we can stream it to our heart's content with a Netflix subscription , I needed to dig up all the fun behind-the-scenes facts I learned from writer/director Curry Barker. Each of these made me think of the movie in a whole different way! Let’s get into it. (SPOILERS ahead.)

I’m always curious about how movies change over time, and Barker told CinemaBlend about one pivotal scene that he played around with a lot. The writer/director was also the movie’s editor on the $750k independent production, and he told us about one exchange he tried a bunch of different ways . In his words:

This sort of blew my mind because this is the scene I was playing over and over in my head after seeing the movie. It’s an important scene because it establishes Bear and Nikki’s relationship before Nikki loses her autonomy. Watching that scene made me wonder if Bear could have had a shot with Nikki if he had simply asked her out rather than using the One Wish Willow. With that in mind, I totally see why this scene would have needed tweaking, but I think it's perfect now.

When I first watched Obsession , I felt a chill down my spine when Bear called the number on the back of the One Wish Willow box. Then, I subsequently had so many questions about what was going on! When I talked to Barker about this scene, he revealed he was the one on the other side of the line.

What a fun cameo! I had no idea Barker was the voice , but it’s a fun little tidbit I’ll always think about when I watch that scene. He gave us some interesting insight about what’s going on with that phone call, too. I'm never forgetting Nikki's screams on the other line.

One more BTS detail I want to share has to do with what didn’t make it into the film. Obsession really goes hard in the paint on the movie rating scale, so I was curious if there was a scene the director had to remove because it went too far. The answer is, yes, there was one moment.

So, what was that “one thing”? During a Q&A (via Deadline ), Barker revealed it was the scene where Nikki kills Sarah by smashing her head into the steering wheel. Barker said there was originally “about six or seven more smashes." The MPA ratings board was going to give the movie a NC-17 rating because of it. At first, Barker wasn’t happy about making the change, but when he saw the movie with an audience (and heard their reactions), he realized the number they landed on was “the right number” to choose.

articles.summary: Image Courtesy of Paramount+ Avatar: Seven Havens might be approachable for younger audiences and fans of all ages, but those behind the series don't really see it as just a show for kids. Avatar: The Last Airbender originally kicked off the franchise with Nickelodeon decades ago, and with it introduced animation fans to a whole new kind of world […]
articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Avatar: Seven Havens might be approachable for younger audiences and fans of all ages, but those behind the series don't really see it as just a show for kids. Avatar: The Last Airbender originally kicked off the franchise with Nickelodeon decades ago, and with it introduced animation fans to a whole new kind of world through its run. Then it was taken in an even darker direction with releases like The Legend of Korra and Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender in the years since . For Avatar: Seven Havens , it kind of sits in the middle.

Avatar: Seven Havens might star a very young set of twin Avatars for this new era of the franchise, and it might be designed in a different way than The Legend of Korra , but it takes on some intense subject matter that's especially seen withe final episodes of the debut season. As executive producer Sehaj Sethi explained in a Reddit AMA for the series, the team always intended to make it "accessible to a younger audience, but also be very interesting to older viewers."

"Personally, I think this show really isn’t a kids show," Sethi stated when asked about whether or not Avatar: Seven Havens was intended for audiences around Pavi and Nisha's age of 10-11. "The themes we cover are quite dark and mature. We always intended for this show to technically be accessible to a younger audience, but also be very interesting to older viewers ." Elaborating on this further, Sethi explained that they're not holding back on putting Pavi and Nisha through the wringer, "Even though Nisha and Pavi are children, we don’t hold back on making them face truly traumatic experiences."

Series producer Ethan Spaulding teased that Avatar: Seven Havens is going to get darker from here on out as well, "[T]he show definitely gets darker as the story progresses," but played coy as to whether or not it has a chance of getting as dark as The Legend of Korra did. Either way, this is something that has already been put in place with the final episodes of the first season as it has tackled xenophobia, isolationism, fear as a result of that and more. With Pavi exploring more Havens in the coming season , we're bound to see more of these intense topics.

Avatar: Seven Havens has been in development for the past few years before the first season finally premiered, and speaking to ComicBook, stars Aishu Devan (Nisha) and Saheli Khan (Pavi) revealed that they had been working on the show since they were 10-11 years old themselves. Noting that production on the third and fourth season had already begun, all they could tease was that there would be plenty of "character development" for the twins moving forward. So it seems like Pavi and Nisha are going to age alongside all of the events in the series.

It won't be too much longer before we see what's next as Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 is already scheduled to kick off its run with Paramount+ beginning on May 21st next year. The new season will be 13 episodes long, and then followed by 13 more episodes with Season 3 releasing later in 2027. The series will then come to an end with Season 4 some time after, so how do you feel about Avatar: Seven Havens right now? Is it a kids show? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

articles.title: Obi-Wan Kenobi Simps Would Have Loved To Own This Piece Of Ewan McGregor's Star Wars History
articles.summary: Hello there! Are you discussing the best ever Jedi in the Star Wars universe is? articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google Hello there! Are you discussing the best ever Jedi in the Star Wars universe is? Of course, Anakin Skywalker is a good shout, considering he's the chosen one, and is also the protagonist of the prequel trilogy and The Clone Wars animated series. There's Yoda too, with his wisdom and unique lightsaber technique. And let's not forget Luke. However, the truth is that it's not even a debate. Obi-Wan Kenobi is the best Jedi Master of all time. Fans love him so much that someone paid $6,000 for his Padawan braid from 1999's Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace . Anyone who doubts his credentials should remember that he took down Darth Maul after watching him slay his master, made General Grievous flee in fear, and beat Anakin/Darth Vader twice. Even in his third canonical duel with Vader, Kenobi lets the Sith Lord strike him down.

The braid was worn by Ewan McGregor in The Phantom Menace , whose voice, mannerisms, and sheer sass went on to make him one of the fan favorite characters from the prequel trilogy, as well as The Clone Wars . The 17″ long braid is meant to signify that he is a Padawan under the tutelage of a Jedi Master, namely Qui-Gon Jinn. Unfortunately, Kenobi would soon have to give up the braid very quickly due to the death of Qui-Gon, and face the harsh reality of training his own Padawan. Of course, the fact that his Padawan was the Chosen One and a complete wildcard didn't make it easy. The braid is in decent shape overall, but features some adhesive residue from when it was stuck to McGregor's head, but that's an added bonus, as it may contain traces of the actor's real hair in it. You know… for those you care for such things.

While it may seem like just a bunch of long hair to some, Star Wars fans will know that it represents the origins of one of the franchise's most important characters. In fact, if it wasn't for Obi-Wan, Palpatine's plans for a Galactic Empire would have likely come to fruition much sooner, and there would be no one to steer Luke towards his destiny all those decades later. If you want to take the entire canon into consideration, he also orchestrated decisive victories against the Separatists during the Clone Wars. And to think he started off as a bright eyed Padawan with this very braid. He eventually went on to achieve great things, and even greater hair.

While this item is definitely an amazing collectible for fans and Obi-Wan stans, it presents a slight challenge when it comes to display. While you can mount Darth Vader's lightsaber on a display stand or a shelf, showing off Obi-Wan Kenobi's Padawan braid is a bit more complicated. You might have to create a custom case which displays the braid in a nicely laid out manner. Regardless of whether the new owner will display it or not, it's an amazing collectible, connected to arguably the greatest Jedi that has ever lived.

Who do you think is the greatest Jedi Master of all time? Let us know in the comments!

“Line extensions” are when business use existing products or intellectual property to expand how they can take advantage of markets, like, for example, video game movie adaptations. articles.content:
Never mind who’s onstage at this year’s Kennedy Center Honors. Keep an eye on the banners.

Donald Trump ’s efforts to put his name on the performing arts institution continue to be thwarted by a federal court. But this year, while the Kennedy Center’s main building is closed for renovations — and still, after five months, remains shrouded by a tarp hiding the building’s original signage — the Dec. 7 honors ceremony is moving to Washington’s Capital One Arena, where the judge’s no-name-changing order may not apply. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Business Trump Says Federal Film Tax Credit Is Gaining Momentum Movies Mind the Gap: British Producer-Financier Phil Hunt Is Bringing Head Gear Stateside

“The injunction may only block Trump from affixing his name to the physical building that’s owned by the federal government,” says a source familiar with the Kennedy Center’s inner workings, noting that it remains “a very good question” as to whether there will be “Trump-Kennedy Center” branding at the Capital One event. After all, we know how much the president loves top billing.

If Trump’s name does end up on posters and programs, it’s unlikely the recipients will object too strenuously. This year’s crop of honorees — David Mamet, Paul Anka, David Foster, Andy Garcia and Barbara Mandrell — ranges from outspoken Trump admirers to, at least publicly, Trump agnostics. Mamet has enthusiastically championed the president; Anka performed a modified version of “My Way” at Mar-a-Lago (“When we vote your way”); and Foster hosted a fund-raiser for Trump-backed L.A. mayoral candidate Spencer Pratt.

Also in normal times, honorees were traditionally announced in midsummer. But this year, like last, they came months later. The holdup in 2025 was apparently because of Tom Cruise, who kept the board dangling while considering the invitation before finally deciding he had “scheduling conflicts.” It’s unknown who, if anyone, kept the board hanging this year, but they still haven’t announced a lineup of presenters and performers.
